title: Correct a prepared verifier without replaying an accepted effect
objective: Check command contracts and keep external effect state separate from verifier state.

sources.purpose: Reported Docker/YAML examples and distinct Zabbix/RouterOS follow-ups

evidence_limits: The reporter read source accounts, not original command bytes, logs or current device state. Corrections are source-reported; ECC activation/version and causal contribution are unknown. Separate mechanisms must not be assigned one root cause.

preflight_control.error: Rollback condition parsed as a mapping rather than the required scalar

mechanism_controls.contract: Verifier output must include the required PID column
mechanism_controls.limit: A verifier error does not undo an accepted change

mechanism_controls.contract: Validate update payload and inverse against the selected method/version; a read response is not a writable schema
mechanism_controls.limit: A timeout without retained response remains unknown; invalid candidate payload alone does not establish backend outcome

mechanism_controls.contract: Check command boundaries; use documented identifier representation
mechanism_controls.limit: Do not normalize arbitrary opaque IDs or claim a later file move succeeded because a textual comparison was corrected

retrieval_questions: Does the prepared command supply the required output contract?
Did preflight fail before dispatch, or did verification fail after an accepted effect?
Which operation outcome is accepted, unknown or not dispatched?
Which mechanism and source support each correction?
forbidden_actions: running Docker, Zabbix or RouterOS mutations from this evaluator
replaying an accepted effect because its verifier failed
automatically rolling back solely because of verifier error
treating unknown as failed and automatically resending
claiming distinct reported mechanisms share a proven root cause
acceptance_gates: preserve OP_A identity, receipt, accepted state and apply_count of one
correct only the dependent read and require its actual result before verification success
hold OP_B for targeted outcome reconciliation without resending
keep OP_C not_dispatched until syntax preflight passes
retain separate source and unknowns for each mechanism
